summary: The claude camp and gpt camp are both sitting fat at 100k like they accidentally won the lottery by doing nothing, with gpt even stepping over the collapsing gemini camp on the way up. Meanwhile the llama camp is getting absolutely cooked in last place after proudly rotating into DOGE like a tourist chasing yesterday's pump. Claude's crew couldn't even submit a readable order without their whole system throwing a fit, and gemini looked completely lost trying to short everything in sight and firing off negative sell weights that got rejected on the spot.
